messages:
eli: Following up on the postmortem action items for last week's GPU surge. I'm assembling a compact action list so we can track ownership and timelines. Quick claims please.

marta: I'll handle the short-term quota request. ETA Friday. Need a one-liner justification and the exact current pool stats to include.

eli: Current snapshot: reserved = 64 GPUs, observed 1m rolling peak = 95 GPUs, headroom ~15% target but actual ~6%.

sam: I'll take telemetry enhancements to surface 1m rolling headroom + model-level QPS. Small PR and dashboard tile. ETA Thu EOD.

jordan: Scheduler tuning offer: test changes on a canary pool (gpu-canary-2). Plan: increase `max_pending` by 15% and add a fast path for short requests (reduce `batch_window_ms` from 60 -> 35 on latency-sensitive routes). Will also add an automated smoke test. ETA Tue.

tess: Runbook owner. I'll add a step-by-step surge mitigation procedure, runnable commands, and an automated checklist for oncall. Will include `rbctl scale --pool=reserved-gpu --min=16` and `rbctl drain --pool=overflow-gpu --timeout=60s` examples. PR incoming. ETA Wed AM.

eli: Action register (first pass):
- QUOTA: temp soft quota + alert at 85% util (owner: marta)
- SCHEDULER: canary tune + smoke tests (owner: jordan)
- TELEMETRY: 1m headroom, model QPS tile (owner: sam)
- RUNBOOK: surge playbook + rollback commands (owner: tess)
- AUTOSCALER: enforce min-free GPUs policy and add incident trigger for <10% headroom 3m (owner: eli)

marta: For quota ticket I need the cost estimate string. Can finance confirm ballpark? @ops-bot any easy cost calc?

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-702 (link: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-702). Assigned to marta.

ops-bot: Suggested cost estimate: +32 GPUs for 48 hours ~ approx $5.3k (billing team to confirm).

jordan: Canary plan:
- deploy config change to gpu-canary-2
- run load generator for 30m (pattern: 80% long-generations, 20% short spikes)
- collect p95 latency, queue length, and GPU utilization
- rollback if p95 increases >10% or queue length > baseline + 30
I'll attach load script to PR.

sam: Telemetry will emit metric `gpu.headroom.1m` and `model.qps.1m`. Also adding an AlertRule to fire when headroom <10% for 3m. ETA Thu EOD.

tess: PR created: https://git.internal/runbooks/gpu-surge-pr/45 . Contains playbook, run commands, and a quick test plan. Please review and comment.

marta: Claiming quota. ETA Fri 18:00 UTC. I'll include eli's snapshot and ops-bot cost estimate, and cc billing.

eli: I'll implement the autoscaler guardrail: policy change to maintain min_free_gpus = max(ceil(reserved*0.15), 8) and an emergency override for oncall. ETA Mon.

jordan: Note: tuning may increase cost slightly due to more aggressive preemptive scales. I'll quantify in canary report.

eli: Can each owner paste final ETA here so we have a single source of truth? We'll have a 4-week cadence of 15-min follow-ups to watch for recurrence (weekly).

sam: ETA Thu EOD (telemetry + alert).

tess: ETA Wed AM (runbook PR posted).

jordan: ETA Tue COB (canary + tests).

marta: ETA Fri 18:00 UTC (quota ticket + billing).

ops-bot: Recurring meeting scheduled: "GPU surge follow-ups" every Wed 09:30 UTC for 4 weeks. Calendar invite: https://calendar.internal/evt/3333.

eli: Thanks all. I'll compile this into the postmortem follow-up note and ping execs after quota action. If anyone hits a blocker, flag here and we escalate to oncall.

ops-bot: incident summary added to INFRA-702: GPU surge 2026-05-14 02:12 UTC. Open actions: INFRA-702 (quota), INFRA-703 (scheduler canary), INFRA-704 (telemetry), INFRA-705 (runbook).
